Episode 247: Liberation War of Lafrarosa (13)
The fusion of Battle God had been dissolved.
However, what Lokia couldn't destroy was the interconnected inner world of the Plutonians, which didn't necessarily require such martial arts.
Therefore, Jin had to unfold the final chapter of the Plutonian Domination Sword without Vahn's senses, but it didn't matter. He already saw it very clearly.
The way Vahn unfolded the will when using the Plutonian Domination Sword, and how he, still not as perfect as the real Battle God, could realize this secret technique in a way similar to hers.
Plutonian Battle God Sword Technique No.10
Plutonian Domination Sword - Wave
Splash...
Suddenly, a soft ripple, like stepping on water, pushed away the battlefield's roar. The fiercely rampaging golden thunder quietly circled around Jin, like a gentle flowing river.
While circling, it was engulfing Kri. Like an erased painting, the 'space' where Kri existed was being absorbed into the Demon King Domination Sword and disappearing.

Over the transparent golden river, the battlefield was reflected. The distorted forms of Kri and the air fortresses, and the chaos dimension portals appearing in the sky were all just transparent in it.
Kri and chaos energy could not inflict any harm in this golden world, not even a drop of thunder energy could tarnish it.
"With your petty power and authority, who do you dare to kill?"
The thunder energy of the Demon King Domination Sword was gradually turning white. Flowing ever more clearly, it shimmered in pure white.
The noise was subsiding.

Not because Lokia and the Kri and air fortresses she controlled had stopped their movements. Lokia was releasing chaos energy more violently than ever since the battle began. The air fortresses were incessantly spewing red brain and chaos energy and firing cannons.
But all that noise was sinking into the white light. Not just the ear-splitting explosions, but even the tiny sounds of sand grains fluttering were all settling into the light, becoming tranquil.
'I can't breathe...'
Lokia's real body currently exists in a different dimension from this world. She is confronting Jin through her spirit form.
Yet, she felt as if her breath was stopping, like drowning in water.

The battle in the great desert, no matter how it progressed, was supposed to be absolutely safe for her in 'Lokia's World.' It seemed as if it was now exposed right in the middle of the battlefield. It shouldn't be possible, yet it seemed so.
Unknowingly, Lokia often touched her own neck and heart, as the image of Sigmund passing through her filled her vision as if it were real.
‘But to fear death, I've already died too many times. Breaking this sword may be too much for me, but cursing your Battle God is certainly within my capabilities.’
Time was slowing down. As if hindered by something physical, the pace of time on the battlefield began to crawl.
Only Jin, Murakan, and Lokia could move at their normal speed in this slowed time. The Kings and the floating fortresses were all adjusting to the slower pace.
For Lokia, it was an overwhelming task. She was forcibly opposing the power of the Plutonian Domination Sword, trying to curse Lafrarosa and kill Vahn by any means necessary.
If she succeeded, she could somewhat recover her twisted plans. More importantly, even without Vahn now, Jin's potential to fulfill that role was clearly evident.
The task of cutting down the witch.
‘I can't stop your sword from destroying my ethereal bodies and weapons, just as you can't stop my curse from striking Lafrarosa. We are not omnipotent beings like the Sun God or the witch.’
Suddenly, a sticky, black liquid trickled down from the center of Lafrarosa's dimensional gate.
The soul energy that had been present in the gate since it first opened in the desert was transforming into a curse, "The Witch's Pool."
Even Jin could not prevent it in advance. This curse had essentially started inside Lafrarosa.
Jin burst into laughter again.
[A curse... It must be a special kind I'm unaware of. You seem to have lost your sense of reality. Trying to threaten Sister Vahn with such a curse is a first for someone like you.]
Lokia couldn't respond to Jin's mocking voice. Her ethereal body was being sucked into and dissolving in the flow of the Plutonian Domination Sword every moment.
Jin saw right through Lokia's intentions.
[Sure, Vahn may be fine, but it might pose a danger to the other brothers. But the reason I couldn't stop your curse is simply that it started outside the range of my sword.]
Jin couldn't preemptively block Lokia's curse because it had originated inside Lafrarosa. If the curse had manifested in the same dimension, the same space, he could have easily blocked it.
[I assure you, Sister Vahn cannot be killed by such a curse. This isn't like a thousand years ago when one could easily crumble an opponent with curses or history.]

Of course, Lokia had anticipated that Vahn might block the curse through the Plutonian Domination Sword or some special power. However, she was confident that the process would inevitably lead to his death or a similar level of damage, considering the prolonged battles he had endured. Just days ago, he had to withstand daily attacks from the Red Plutonian and Zipple, and he had already shared much of his power with Jin through the Battle God fusion.
Even for a Battle God of the Plutonian race, there are limits. Yet, Jin's faith in Vahn was stronger than ever.
[I didn't even need to twist the battlefield's time with the Plutonian Domination Sword. After all, your time stopped a thousand years ago. Now, you have no moves left.]
Jin had made his decision.
There was nothing more to hinder him. Now, by driving out Lokia and destroying Kri and the floating fortresses.
The Battle for the Liberation of Lafrarosa was coming to an end. Jin and his brothers' wishes were about to become reality.
In two different dimensions, in Lafrarosa and in the human world, the Battle God and their successors were unfolding the Plutonian Domination Sword.
Jin and Vahn were picturing each other's forms. Though they stood in different spaces, they were as if dancing the sword together.
[Sister Luntia and Bale, please join the defense of the Lafrarosa gateway.]
Bale, summoned by Jin's call, was just entering the battlefield with reinforcements. He watched Lokia's ethereal bodies dissolve in the Plutonian Domination Sword without much comment.

He was rather mesmerized by the final chapter of the Plutonian Domination Sword. Although it felt somewhat lacking compared to the 'Final' used by the Battle Goddess Vahn at the Demon God War, it seemed all the more beautiful for that reason.
[Alright.]
"Understood."

[Carefully observe the flow of my sword and energy. Surely, the effects of Sister Vahn's Plutonian Domination Sword will pour through the cracks. Even those effects will have much in common with my sword, so sister, you can use that as a reference to block them.]
"Won't that interfere with you dealing with it?"
[No, even if you and Bale aren't there, Sister Vahn's sword won't hinder me. But, I mean to say, protect Luna sister.]
"Oh, protect elder sister Luna!?"
[Exactly, it's more like sister Luna's battle. Today is not only the day I liberate the brothers of Lapra Rosa, but also the last chance for sister Luna.]
As Eltiot's disciple, it was Luna's last chance to confront Shimat.
Before coming to the desert, Luna had been aware of Shimat. If Jin defeated him before she arrived, she would never have the opportunity to face him as Eltiot's disciple.
"Ah, right. It's an important matter for eldest sister."
"Wow, our youngest is so relaxed even in this situation. Are you really going to leave Shimat to me?"
[Elder Sister Luna, Shimat may have lost all his fortresses, but fighting with me has awakened him. In some ways, he's stronger than when you took the Red Plutonian parts from Eltiot.]

"I was just looking for a strong opponent. I have something to repay him. Hehe, I can finally fight him one-on-one. I was worried that such an opportunity might never come. Of course, the safety of the family and alliance comes first."
[I didn't foresee this situation from the start. It just happened to align this way.Once Luntia destroys all the aerial fortresses, Shimat can fight you with a clear mind.]
Jin spoke with such calmness as if there were no enemies before him.
Lokia no longer seemed threatening. Jin had read all her moves, neutralized the elements she intended to use as the core of this battle, and even found clues to her pocket dimension.
And now, Lokia's ethereal body and Kri were not withstanding the final chapter of Plutonian Domination Sword. Kri's cannon never managed to strike Lafrarosa.
The only effective move she had was the curse, which Vahn's Domination Sword was currently blocking.
Luna, Luntia, and Bale departed to their respective positions.

[Hiding somewhere and sending a clone, thinking she can control everything safely... it feels familiarly pitiful. Now I see, it's the same thing Joshua did in the past. He used to act as if no one loved Runcandel more than he did.]
Jin pointed Sigmund at Kri, pressing heavily in the sky.
As he slowly dragged the blade down, the massive body of Kri tilted and descended accordingly.

Suddenly, as the bottom of Kri touched the ground, a surge of lightning created a white foam. It looked as if an island was sinking. Kri's unique transparency couldn't avoid the lightning's impact. It just crumbled like a piece of ice thrown under the sun.

[Soon, I'll find your main body and all your kin, Lokia Ganesto, and end your dark life. After today, I'll eradicate the likes of you with my comrades and siblings. Those who can't let the world be and are always disrupting it.]
